title: Chapter 593 - 593 Master; Immortal Technique! (1)
content:
Chapter 593 - 593 Master; Immortal Technique! (1)

Chapter 593 - 593 Master; Immortal Technique! (1)

593 Master; Immortal Technique! (1)

Lin Fan looked at Sam deeply.

“Are you going to keep kneeling?”

“Yes!” Sam said seriously.

Lin Fan said, “Then you can kneel. I’m leaving.”

After saying that, he walked straight ahead.

Sam knelt on the ground and looked at Lin Fan’s back as he walked away. He could not help but shout, “Master…”

However, it was as if Lin Fan did not hear him at all. He did not even turn his head back as he continued to move forward.

At this moment, a ferocious beast’s roar sounded in the distant wilderness.

Sam was so scared that his whole body trembled and he shouted, “Master, please wait for me.”

After saying that, Sam almost rolled and crawled as he quickly chased after him.

…

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

“Professor Lin is still so powerful!” Xiao Bing said excitedly. “He killed a ferocious beast with a casual swing of his sword! Moreover, it has also reduced the pollution in Hua Nation by 10%.”

Pardon: [One Slash!]

Zhao Dahai: [Hua kung fu! Sam is so funny.]

Are You Happy: [That’s right! Sam, Hua kung fu is just that powerful!]

You’ll Be Cold Without My Embrace: [Want to take God Lin as your master? You’re still far from it.]

Clear as Day: [Sam, aren’t you going to keep kneeling? Hahaha!]

…

In a luxurious manor in Bai Nation.

The Gilbeven family was sitting in the luxurious living room, staring at the screen without blinking.

When Sam Gilbeven was drenched in sweat, the whole family was heartbroken.

When Sam accidentally fell to the ground, the whole family felt the same way and almost cried.

When Sam was being chased by the Megalodon Lion, the whole family burst into tears. It was as if they had been eaten by the Megalodon.

“Why does our Sam have to suffer so much?”

“Why was he chosen?”

“God, what did we do wrong?”

“Please God, don’t let anything happen to him.”

…

It was not until Lin Fan appeared and killed the Megalodon Lion that the Gilbeven family stopped crying and started shouting excitedly.

“That’s great!”

“Thank you, Hua Nation’s Lin!”

“Thank you, Hua Nation’s Lin!”

“Hua Nation! I have to go to Hua Nation now to thank Lin’s family.”

“Sam will be Lin’s disciple in the future. Let’s go visit his family!”

The Gilbeven family left immediately. They took a luxury plane and flew straight to Hua Nation.

On the same day, the news of the richest family in Bai Nation heading to Hua Nation made the headlines of international financial news.

When they arrived at Jiangbei International Airport, they were immediately interviewed by many media outlets.

However, the Gilbevens did not have any intention of being interviewed.

They boarded the Rolls-Royce motorcade and headed straight for Qing City.

At this moment, Lin Tao, Dai Weixue, and Lin Xiaoyao were sitting in front of the television as usual, watching the live broadcast seriously.

At this moment, there was a light knock on the door.

Dai Weixue replied, “Coming!”

When the door opened, there were many foreigners in white clothes with brown skin.

This made Dai Weixue a little confused.

What was going on?

Why were there so many foreigners here?

At this moment, a bearded Gilbeven family member said excitedly, “You’re… Grandma, right?”

Grandma?

Dai Weixue’s forehead creased.

Grandma?

Did she look that old?

“Hello, Grandma,” the person from earlier said seriously.

Then, everyone said in unison, “Hello, Grandma.”

Dai Weixue’s forehead creased even more.

Lin Tao, who was watching the live broadcast in the living room, heard the sound at the door and asked, “What happened?”

As he spoke, he slowly left the sofa and came to the door.

“Hello, Grandpa!”

Then, everyone shouted in unison, “Hello, Grandpa!”

Dai Weixue’s and Lin Tao’s faces darkened.

Lin Xiaoyao, who was originally focused on watching the live broadcast, walked out of curiosity.

“Hello, Aunt!”

Dai Weixue, Lin Tao, and Lin Xiaoyao were all speechless.

Were they that old?

After a while, Lin Tao suppressed the urge to hit them and asked, “My foreign friends, are you mistaken?”

“You’re God Lin’s father, aren’t you?”

Lin Tao nodded.

“That’s right!” Dean Gilbeven said happily. “I’m Sam Gilbeven’s father. This is his mother…”

Dean Gilbeven introduced them one by one.

Then, he said, “We and Sam want to worship God Lin as our master. So, from now on, you’re our grandpa, grandma, and aunt!”

When Lin Tao, Dai Weixue, and Lin Xiaoyao heard this, their mouths twitched.

When they watched the live broadcast earlier, they thought that Sam was very interesting, and they thought that his family must be very interesting too.

Now, it seemed that this had nothing to do with being interesting!

At this moment, there was the sound of footsteps outside.

Then, a middle-aged man in a white shirt strode over.

When he saw the Gilbeven family, he smiled and said, “Welcome to Qing City, Gilbeven family. I’m the leader of Qing City, Zhao Jiaqi.”

Earlier, Dean Gilbeven had been speaking in a servile manner.

At this moment, he straightened his back and said, “Oh, it’s the big leader. Hello.”
